output.title: Holiday Sides 3 Ways
output.description:
Three holiday sides, plus the crispy shallots for the casserole.

MY GEAR:
CUTTING BOARD: https://example.com/board
FINE MESH STRAINER: https://example.com/strainer

POTATO PUREE
2kg russet potatoes, peeled and diced
230g unsalted butter
175g heavy cream
10g salt

Boil the potatoes until tender. Drain, then mash in the butter and the cream. Pass through a strainer and season with the salt.

STUFFING
500g white bread, cubed
115g butter
300g onion, diced
200g celery, diced
2 eggs
500g chicken stock

Dry the bread in a low oven. Cook the onion and celery in the butter. Whisk the eggs into the stock, toss everything together and bake covered, then uncovered until crisp.

GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
900g green beans, trimmed
115g butter
450g mushrooms, diced
65g flour
400g chicken stock
Crispy fried shallots (or onions) - see recipe below

Blanch the beans. Cook the mushrooms in the butter, stir in the flour, then the stock, and simmer. Fold in the beans, top with the shallots and bake.

FRIED SHALLOTS
250g shallots, sliced into rings
200g flour
225g buttermilk
canola oil

Toss the shallots in the flour, then the buttermilk, then the flour again. Fry in 175C oil until golden.
